The Raipur–Visakhapatnam Expressway is a landmark infrastructure project under Bharatmala Pariyojana, set to revolutionize connectivity between Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh. Here's why this expressway is making headlines:
Discover the Marvel of OD5: Raipur-Visakhapatnam Expressway!
Hello friends! Join us on an incredible journey through Package OD5 of the Raipur-Visakhapatnam Expressway, located in the breathtaking Koraput region of Odisha. This stretch is nothing short of an engineering marvel, featuring:
Massive viaducts spanning 1.140 km.
